name: HomeWizard P1 meter
description: Power now, electricity in and out, and gas, from the meter on your smart meter
comment: API v1 over plain HTTP. Every field is optional and left out when the smart meter does not send it. total_gas_m3 is the older top-level gas field; whether newer firmware only reports gas under external[] is unverified. HomeWizard will phase out v1 in favour of v2 (HTTPS with a token).

placeholders.label: IP address of the P1 meter
placeholders.hint: In the HomeWizard Energy app, under Settings, Meters, your meter: turn on Local API. The app shows the IP address there too.

rule.summary: show Power now in the warning colour above 3000 W
